Part of #27377 (wave 4, W4-L2)

Selector `release-18.3.0-w4-l2`: the Tier 1 live legs for half B of the 18.3.0 release-candidate sweep, wave 4, for the 37 items in dashboards, i18n, identity-auth, integration-system, platform-core and search. The pins-only record #28965 (W4-C2b) ran each item's `automated.ref` at this same subject and left 119 items PARTIAL across W4-L1/L2/L3 because no pin reached their live or browser legs. This card drives those legs. It is a coverage fix for #28965, dispatched from the 18.3.0 release-planning thread after the maintainer approved it (2026-11-02 07:06Z). It is a QA run, not a lane card.

**Result: 37/37 judged · 32 PASS / 2 PARTIAL / 3 FAIL / 0 BLOCKED / 0 NOT-RUN.** No item is `planned`. Clause rows: 320 (one per acceptance and negative clause): 314 pass, 4 fail, 1 blocked, 1 skipped; 250 driven live, 70 kept from #28965.

**Scope rule.** Every clause #28965 marked `partial`, `skipped` or `blocked` was judged live on a booted stack (API, CLI or browser as the clause asks). Every clause #28965 marked `pass` keeps that verdict and is cited as `pins #28965`, not re-run. Item verdicts are derived from both, per RUNNER.md.

## 1. Environment fingerprint

- **Framework:** `objectstack-ai/objectstack` @ `7fa9873f38f7a0158e3ce17338dcc0f446b113e3`, a detached worktree that never followed `main` or the Version PR #26517. `ui/` is in the same tree; the console was built from it.
- **Build:** cold tree. `npm_config_nodedir=/opt/node22 pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` (25 s), then `pnpm exec turbo run build --concurrency=2 && pnpm console:build` under `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`: 118/118 tasks, 19m07s; `check-dev-prereqs` 106 artefacts present. Node v22.23.4, pnpm 10.31.0, Playwright chromium build 1243 from `/opt/pw-browsers`, 4 CPUs, about 15 GiB.
- **Boots:** every boot ran from a scratch copy of the app (the app tarred without `node_modules`, `dist`, `.objectstack`, with `node_modules` symlinked back), never from the tree: `OS_PORT=P OS_STORAGE_LOCAL_ROOT=RUN/uploads OS_HOME=RUN/home setsid node TREE/packages/cli/bin/run.js dev --ui --seed-admin --no-watch -p P -d file:RUN/data-P.db`. Each runner group had its own port range (42100–42279), its own file DBs and its own copies; item-specific env was added as each item's fixtures say (walled `group` / `isolated` boots with `OS_TENANCY_POSTURE`, `OS_PLATFORM_OWNER_EMAIL=admin@objectos.ai`, `OS_AUTH_MEMBERSHIP_POLICY=invite-only`; `OS_SEARCH_PINYIN_ENABLED=false`; `OS_SSO_ENABLED`, `OS_SSO_DOMAIN_VERIFICATION`, `OS_OIDC_PROVIDER_ENABLED=false`, `OS_AUTH_ADMIN=false`; `NODE_ENV=production` with `OS_SECRET_KEY`; `--log-level info` where a clause reads INFO lines). Scratch copies of `examples/app-todo` and a staged unbuilt-console checkout were used where an item names them. After the run `examples/app-showcase/.objectstack` did not exist in the tree and `git status` was clean.
- **Fixture doubles:** a localhost OIDC provider (account linking, SSO, the matrix), an echo upstream (connector auth wire shapes), the shipped `ImapServerDouble` from `@objectstack/connector-imap/testing` (inbound mailbox), scratch flows and translation bundles (flow copy, surface matrix confirm), all inside scratch copies.
- **Seed:** `--seed-admin` (admin@objectos.ai) plus the stock showcase seed; members minted by invite then sign-up, or by `admin/create-user` then `change-password` (RUNNER environment facts).
- **Browser:** headless Chromium via Playwright, form sign-in (both auth halves), at most three browser runners at once. Screenshots were live judgment aids only; each is described in one line of text in the per-clause table.
- **Clock:** 2026-11-02 07:13Z to 08:20Z (UTC).
- **Execution:** the card session built the tree and verified the boot recipe, then fanned the 37 items out to nine runner subagents (effort high) in groups by area, at most six at once. Each runner read RUNNER.md, the dogfood skill and its items in full, and returned a per-clause table with text evidence. The card session checked every table against the item JSON (clause count and order) and re-checked one accuracy finding with a follow-up run (§7, `platform-core.metadata-authoring-roundtrip`).

## 5. FAILs: reproduction rules and dispositions

**F-1 · integration-system.email-template-render · acceptance[7] · product defect → #29152**
1. Boot the showcase (any stock boot), sign in as admin@objectos.ai.
2. `POST /api/v1/email/send` body `{"to":"not-an-address","subject":"QA bad-to","text":"x"}`.
3. Expected (acceptance[7]): 400 with a ledgered code (VALIDATION_FAILED for a bad message shape), never a 500 for caller-fixable input. Actual: **500** `{"code":"EMAIL_SEND_FAILED","error":"Invalid email address: not-an-address"}`. The same for `to:""`, a list with one bad member, `to:"a@b"` and `cc:"bad-cc"`. A `sys_email` row is written `failed`, error `rejected before delivery: Invalid email address: …`.
- Self-check: a well-formed `to` from the same client answers 200; `subject:""` answers 400 VALIDATION_FAILED, so the route's 400 path works; stale-dist ruled out (the throw text is in the built `plugin-email` dist of this tree). Reproduced on two separate boots.
- Mechanism: `formatAddress` (`packages/plugins/plugin-email/src/email-service.ts:284-288`) throws without the `VALIDATION_FAILED:` prefix the other `normalizeMessage` refusals carry; the route (`packages/rest/src/email-routes.ts:335`) maps only prefixed errors to 400, so this one reaches the 500 at :346.

**F-2 · i18n.surface-matrix · negative[1] · product defect → #29153**
1. Stock showcase, admin; avatar menu → Language → 中文（中国） (`sys_user.locale = zh-CN`).
2. Open `/_console/apps/com.example.showcase/showcase_contact?form=CONTACT_ID` (the default contact form).
3. Read the help line under 线索评分. Expected `由评分规则计算,不可手动编辑。` (the bundle carries `objects.showcase_contact.fields.lead_score.help`). Actual `Computed by scoring rules — not user-editable.`
4. Server truth: `GET /api/v1/meta/object/showcase_contact` with `Accept-Language: zh-CN` serves `fields.lead_score` as `{inlineHelpText: "Computed by scoring rules — not user-editable.", description: "由评分规则计算,不可手动编辑。"}`.
- Self-check: read after a 5 s settle on two fresh browser contexts, confirmed by screenshot; stale-console-bundle ruled out (`ui/packages/fields/src/fieldHelpText.ts:53` returns `inlineHelpText || description`, matching the served console); wrong-panel ruled out (steps[7] names this form).
- Mechanism: the translator serves a field's `help` only on `description` (`packages/spec/src/system/i18n-resolver.ts:4446-4452`), the extractor sources `help` from `inlineHelpText` since #25683 (`packages/cli/src/utils/i18n-extract.ts:1458-1464`), and the console draws `inlineHelpText` first. Wave 3 read this form for its sections and did not record the help line.

**F-3 · integration-system.connector-auth-kind-application · acceptance[3], negative[1] · stale spec → re-point #29154**
1. In a scratch showcase copy, add to `allConnectors`: `{ name:'qa_probe_oauth2', type:'api', provider:'rest', providerConfig:{baseUrl:'http://127.0.0.1:42181'}, auth:{ type:'oauth2', grant:'client_credentials', tokenUrl:'https://example.invalid/token', clientId:'qa', credentialRef:'QA_OAUTH_SECRET' } }`.
2. `node TREE/packages/cli/bin/run.js compile`.
3. Expected (clauses as written): a parse refusal, the auth discriminator offering exactly the four static kinds. Actual: rc=0, `✓ Build complete`, and the entry with its auth lands in `dist/objectstack.json`; on boot it is listed degraded until its `credentialRef` resolves. Reproduced twice plus one boot.
- Why this is stale spec, not a defect: `ConnectorInstanceAuthSchema` at the subject carries seven kinds (none, bearer, api-key, basic, oauth2, app-credential, signed; `packages/spec/src/shared/connector-auth.zod.ts:601-609`) under ADR-0143 D1 (Accepted 2026-10-28), which moved outbound connector OAuth to the open tier. Wave 3 measured the old four-kind refusal at c4c515ad. Both sides act on their own declarations; the clauses pin the ruled-away shape.

## 7. Partial-coverage gaps, fixture gaps and checklist-accuracy findings

Parked on #27377 in this card's anchor comment (one line each, with the recipe that worked where a gap was closed here). The headline ones: knownGaps that this run closed (enterprise SSO and device authorization for the auth matrix; the IMAP double for inbound mail; an unbuilt-console recipe for serve-composition A5; a live confirm specimen for the surface matrix), steps that no longer match the product (the url-overlay back link is now a top-bar trail; the protocol-18 artifact-copy boot drops the config's connector plugins since #21501; the import-users step needs `format: "json"`; a ViewItem-record body, not an inline view, is what refuses a bare view name), and the two PARTIALs above.

The bare-view-name finding was re-checked by a follow-up run: a ViewItem record (config under `config`) with a bare name is refused 422 `INVALID_METADATA` at `name`; an inline-config view accepts a flat name by design (the `view.zod.ts` header "Name grammar depends on the body spelling", present at 2026-08-31 and 2026-10-16). So `platform-core.metadata-authoring-roundtrip` steps[1] is stale wording, not a lost guard.

## 9. Off-clause probes (RUNNER rule 8)

About 75 runner-minutes in all, 2.5–10 minutes per group, after each group's clauses had verdicts, on the same boots and personas (admin, minted members, delegated and org admins, demo personas, anonymous), with the opposite posture (`group` beside `isolated`/`single`) where a door is posture-sensitive. Doors: analytics query and dataset query; the i18n routes and every overlay URL parameter; invite-member, accept-invitation, update-member-role, change-email, admin ban/impersonate/create-user/set-user-password, API keys, SSO; credential-refs, connector dispatch; the datasource admin and federation doors; email send, email templates, notification mark-read, webhook redeliver, the mailbox; activation switches, protocol ranges, the migration journal, lifecycle edge rows; meta PUT/publish-drafts, settings, the settings ledger. Boundary classes: empty string, missing field, unknown id, wrong type, reserved names, case and padding variants, self-target, readers outside the asserted scope.

Found, and extracted (each card carries `QA-source: #29151 · area.item · observed beside the clauses`):
- #29156 · `POST /analytics/dataset/query` silently ignores unknown top-level body keys, so a misplaced `runtimeFilter` answers 200 with the unfiltered aggregate (beside dashboards.analytics-exposure-gate-and-measure-aggregate).
- #29157 · console `?form=ID` for a record that does not exist opens a blank editable edit overlay instead of a not-found state (beside platform-core.url-overlay-contract).
- #29158 · `invite-member` accepts a blank role and writes an out-of-vocabulary invitation, and under a wall a membership with no org role (beside identity-auth.invitation-scope-gates).
- #29159 · the console login card offers SSO-only copy with no SSO button when email+password is off and no provider exists (beside identity-auth.auth-method-matrix).
- #29161 · the impersonation banner names the administrator by raw user id (beside identity-auth.admin-lifecycle-operations).
- #29163 · `change-email` to the caller's own address answers 400 with no error code (beside identity-auth.auth-method-matrix).
- #29164 · a runtime datasource named `drivers` is accepted but its detail read answers the driver catalog (beside integration-system.datasource-admin-lifecycle).

Observed and not filed (fail the filing gate or are by design; listed for the anchor): `POST …/external/validate` on a managed datasource answers 200 `{ok:true, results:[]}` while the six Sync doors refuse it (#24837 scope, PM to judge); a non-string `table` yields `'[object Object]'` inside a correct 400; an empty `{}` activation body defaults to enabled; unparseable protocol ranges install with a warning (fail-open by design); a refused set-active clears the active organization (upstream, fails closed); the home Activity feed keeps English until a reload after a language switch.
